title: Kestrel: stay asleep, Kestrel watches the chain

lines.text: Sunday, six fifty-five in the morning UTC, on Base. One wallet signs three unlimited approvals. USDC to Permit2. VIBES to Aerodrome. WETH to Uniswap. Nothing looks wrong.
lines.say: Sunday, six fifty-five in the morning UTC, on Base. One wallet signs three unlimited approvals. U S D C to Permit two. Vibes to Aerodrome. W E T H to Uniswap. Nothing looks wrong.

lines.text: But crypto never closes, and people sleep. Overnight, liquidity gets pulled, contracts get upgraded, admin keys change, and an old approval gets drained. By morning, it is history.

Base now makes a block every two hundred milliseconds. That is one hundred forty-four thousand blocks while you sleep. And VIBES lives on two chains at once, Base and Robinhood Chain, where a broken bridge would not wait for you to wake up.
lines.say: Base now makes a block every two hundred milliseconds. That is one hundred forty-four thousand blocks while you sleep. And Vibes lives on two chains at once, Base and Robinhood Chain, where a broken bridge would not wait for you to wake up.

lines.text: Meet Kestrel. Stay asleep. Kestrel watches the chain.

Paste any address on Base or Robinhood Chain. No wallet, no signup. In about a second, Kestrel reads the chain and scores it. That wallet from six fifty-five scores forty-five out of a hundred. Elevated. Three unlimited approvals, all fresh.
Set a watch and go to bed. Every four minutes, Kestrel checks your rules against live blocks. When one fires, Telegram wakes you, with a link straight into the Panic Bunker.

At seven oh seven, the owner opened that link. Kestrel simulated every call first, then guided six signatures. Two revokes. VIBES and WETH swapped to USDC, through exact-size approvals. Thirty-two seconds. Every allowance back to zero. Score: zero.
lines.say: At seven oh seven, the owner opened that link. Kestrel simulated every call first, then guided six signatures. Two revokes. Vibes and W E T H swapped to U S D C, through exact-size approvals. Thirty-two seconds. Every allowance back to zero. Score: zero.

lines.text: Before you trade, simulate the rug. Kestrel replays a whale dump or a pulled pool with exact pool math. And it checks the VIBES bridge on both chains: every token circulating on Robinhood Chain must be locked on Base. Right now, exact.

lines.text: For Vibestarter backers, Backer Shield watches tranche escrows, like the Genesis raise of one hundred twenty-three ETH, and counts down every seventy-two hour challenge window.
lines.say: For Vibe starter backers, Backer Shield watches tranche escrows, like the Genesis raise of one hundred twenty-three E T H, and counts down every seventy-two hour challenge window.

lines.text: AI agents ask Kestrel before they swap. Allow, warn or block. The preview is free. A full verdict costs one cent of USDC over x402, and the first paid call settled on Base at seven twenty-five. Kestrel is an MCP server too, with eleven tools.
lines.say: A I agents ask Kestrel before they swap. Allow, warn or block. The preview is free. A full verdict costs one cent of U S D C over x four oh two, and the first paid call settled on Base at seven twenty-five. Kestrel is an M C P server too, with eleven tools.

lines.text: Under the hood, there is no indexer and no mock data. Every number is read live from public nodes, with its block and an explorer link.
Revoke tools clean up after you wake. Alert bots tell you what already happened. Kestrel watches, warns, and gets you out, while you sleep.
Kestrel. Stay asleep. Kestrel watches the chain. Built for Vibeathon zero two, Night Shift.
